statement: System-generated Ringfence provenance supplement (write-once). It maps the engine's canonical evidence files back to the customer's uploaded files, records how each source column was mapped to a canonical field (method, rule or AI proposal, who decided and confirmed it, validation; values not recorded at the time are shown as not recorded, never inferred) and who took each closure decision. It is not part of the library's final pack and does not change it.
